description: This file defines the Polyline class for drawing polyline overlays on a map, extending the Path class. It includes methods for managing polyline points, calculating bounds, centroids, and handling rendering and interaction logic.

classes.name: Polyline
classes.description: A class for drawing polyline overlays on a map, extending Path, with methods for managing points, bounds, and rendering.

methods.name: getLatLngs
methods.description: Returns the array of points in the polyline.

methods.name: setLatLngs
methods.description: Replaces all points in the polyline with a new array of geographical points and redraws.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the polyline has no points.

methods.name: closestLayerPoint
methods.description: Finds the closest point on the polyline to a given point.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the centroid of the polyline.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the polyline.

methods.name: addLatLng
methods.description: Adds a new point to the polyline and updates bounds.

methods.name: _setLatLngs
methods.description: Converts and sets the internal array of points.

methods.name: _convertLatLngs
methods.description: Recursively converts input into LatLng instances and updates bounds.

methods.name: _project
methods.description: Projects geographical points into pixel coordinates for rendering.

methods.name: _updateBounds
methods.description: Updates the pixel bounds of the polyline.

methods.name: _projectLatlngs
methods.description: Recursively projects latlngs into layer points and updates bounds.

methods.name: _clipPoints
methods.description: Clips the polyline to the renderer bounds for performance.

methods.name: _simplifyPoints
methods.description: Simplifies the polyline segments for performance.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the polyline rendering, including clipping and simplification.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Updates the visual path of the polyline in the renderer.

methods.name: _containsPoint
methods.description: Detects if a point is within the polyline for interactivity.
